bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock Deposits Over $237 Million in Assets to Coinbase Prime
bitcoin_articles.summary: On May 29, 2026, BlackRock transferred 2,448 BTC and 28,683 ETH to Coinbase Prime, continuing its use of the platform for institutional custody.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock Transfers Over $237 Million in Digital Assets to Coinbase
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock executed a transfer of approximately $237 million in Bitcoin and Ethereum to Coinbase Prime.

bitcoin_articles.headline: MicroStrategy Transfers $30 Million in Bitcoin to Coinbase Prime
bitcoin_articles.summary: MicroStrategy has transferred 411.48 BTC, valued at approximately $30.3 million, to Coinbase Prime, marking its first direct exchange deposit in nearly two years.

bitcoin_articles.headline: TBSO Pivots Strategy to AI and Fintech Following Bitcoin Treasury Failure
bitcoin_articles.summary: TBSO, formerly focused on bitcoin accumulation, is pivoting to AI and fintech services and has announced an 8 million euro fundraising project.
